description: This file defines internal details and classes for the Gloo-based process group in PyTorch's distributed package, including registry declarations, stream initialization functions, and classes for asynchronous allreduce operations, including sparse tensor support.

classes.name: AsyncAllreduceWork
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous allreduce operation in the Gloo process group, supporting real and complex tensors, with methods to run the reduction.

classes.name: AsyncAllreduceCoalescedWork
classes.description: A variant of AsyncAllreduceWork that performs coalesced (flattened) tensor reduction for efficiency.

classes.name: AsyncSparseAllreduceWork
classes.description: Handles sparse tensor allreduce operations, including metadata gathering, indices and values allgather, and local reduction.

classes.name: SparseTensorMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about sparse tensors, including dimensions and nnz, used for allgather operations.

methods.name: initializeStreamsEvents
methods.description: Initializes CUDA streams and events for tensors or nested tensor vectors, ensuring synchronization.

methods.name: toFunction
methods.description: Converts a ReduceOp to a corresponding reduction function for non-integer or integer types.

methods.name: band
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on arrays of integral type.

methods.name: bor
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR on arrays of integral type.

methods.name: bxor
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR on arrays of integral type.

methods.name: setInputs
methods.description: Sets input data pointers for reduction options based on tensor data.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets a single input data pointer for reduction options.

methods.name: setOutputs
methods.description: Sets output data pointers for reduction options.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets a single output data pointer for reduction options.

methods.name: pinnedLike
methods.description: Creates a pinned CPU tensor similar to the input tensor.
